The hot-path lane has two posts on this topic:

- [The Hot Path to Claude Is a Shell Script](/hot-path/the-hot-path-to-claude-is-a-shell-script/) (2026-10-22). This is a bash and curl client with no jq. It uses one POST and one stream.
- [A Claude Client in One Go File](/hot-path/a-claude-client-in-one-go-file/) (2026-10-29). This is a Go client built on net/http, encoding/json and a bufio scanner for SSE. It ships as a static binary from a scratch image.
